listing.name: Gears of War 3 — squarehole360 Gears3 (GloriousEggroll)
listing.summary: The project reports playable Linux results and benchmarks for specific scenes. A Windows binary procedure is documented, but Portcove has not tested it. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own GearsOfWar3disc; game-specific XEX profiles/importer verify data. Native renderer copies XDKfunctions from users assets, not redistributed.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Generate code and build from source on Linux, or cross-compile for Windows with xwin. The runtime uses Vulkan1.3 with native Wayland HDR/VRR and an X11 fallback. The recorded review did not find release packages.

warnings: The project reports playable Linux results and benchmarks for specific scenes. A Windows binary procedure is documented, but Portcove has not tested it.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
